''Ishva Verishe Val'' Tesch Val, you must recover, from the archives, the incantation to speed our transit to the new continent. Ishva Rosch Val, our plans have failed. We must escape this continent or risk being slain by the other elders on the council. My place upon the council was forfeit once it became known that I practiced the dark magiks. We must quicken our search for the maps. If we are unable to find the spell which will open the gate to Antonica, then we must acquire another means of travel. Ishva Fear not my brethren! We have taken this home and we shall make it our own! Use what resources we have to establish ourselves here. Care not about the Theth, for they are our inferiors.
